title: Max Styler Was Ready to Quit Dance Music, Now He’s One of Its Buzziest New Artists
summary: The producer's latest EP, I Don't Think I Can Stop, is out today, Aug. 7.
body: Max Styler had been plugging away in dance music for years, and was considering packing it up. “I was sick of my project and thought like, ‘Maybe I’ll just be a ghost producer in the back end, and that’ll be it, because I can’t really figure out what I want to do,” Styler says. Luckily, before that could happen, the California-born artist had a clarifying conversation with the woman who was then his girlfriend and is now his wife. She told him, he recalls, that “‘You just need to make the music you like to listen to and the music people want to dance to.’ She basically told me I needed to make better music.” The simple advice cracked something open for Styler, who, after taking it, has become one of the buzziest new names in dance music. Since 2022, he’s signed tracks to labels including Spinnin Records, John Summit’s Experts Only and Solomun’s Diynamic. He played his first Lollapalooza last weekend, made his Coachella debut in 2025 and is making fans around the world with the extended sets that are his speciality. title: اجتماع حاسم مع ديكو يضع لاعب برشلونة خارج كامب نو

title: رسميا.. ميلان يعلن فسخ عقد بن ناصر

title: اعترافات خطيرة.. بنعطية يهز الأوساط الكروية الفرنسية
summary: تكشف كها غدا

This is the COSMOS field , a patch of sky several times larger than the full moon , first observed by Hubble . It has also been observed by Webb and other telescopes because it contains comparatively few bright stars from our own galaxy, offering a relatively unimpeded view of other galaxies outside the Milky Way .
